data.name: QtyT40I10D100K
data.abstract: Since there is no numerical sequential data stream available in standard data sets, this data set is generated from the original T40I10D100K data set

CustomerID: the ID of the customer who has performed the transaction (randomly generated [1 100])
Time: the time that the transaction has been performed
